Softness and stability combine so you can tap into your best road run yet. Low Mid High Mid Cushion Altra shoes are offered in three cushioning levels (Low, Mid, and High), which are defined by stack height. Some cushions may be built with different materials, but the overall ride is categorized by how much shoe sits between your foot and the ground. 9.8oz / 269g Weight 0mm Heel-to-Toe Drop This refers to the height difference between your heel and forefoot and is always 0mm or 4mm in all Altra shoes. A Zero-to-Low Drop shoe encourages a more efficient, functional movement pattern. Racing Standard Original Standard FootShape™ Fit What is FootShape™ Fit? What is FootShape™ Fit? A shoe with FootShape™ Fit is not a “wide” shoe. It’s a shoe with room for your toes that still keeps your foot secure through the midfoot. Every Altra shoe has our signature FootShape™ for natural movement. However, Altra styles are designed with three FootShape™ Fits for different experiences: Original , Standard , and Racing . Original FootShape™ Fit Our roomiest toe box with space through the midfoot . Standard FootShape™ Fit Room for your toes with a secure midfoot . Racing FootShape™ Fit Room for your toes with a snug midfoot for a secure racing stance. Features Durable traction With a Vibram® XS DURA rubber outsole, you get durability, and a smooth responsiveness, that’s made for grip on whatever the road throws your way. Dual-density midsole foam P35X™ is designed to deliver an energetic, cushioned underfoot feel by combining a soft foam with a firmer one for a stable and comfortable ride. Flexibility and natural movement underfoot FootPod™ technology in the outsole supports your foot’s flexibility and helps the shoe move naturally with your body’s movement, so you can interact with your environment. Roomy toe box for natural movement With Altra’s signature FootShape™ fit, you get plenty of room to help your toes move freely, with a secure midfoot. Promotes good foot health This product received the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) Seal of Acceptance, awarded to products found by the Association to promote good foot health. The Altra Fit Room for your toes for comfort, balance, and strength. Learn More Roomy Toe Box Allows space for your toes to spread out naturally, helping to avoid squished toes for more comfort and balance. Zero-to-Low Drop Our Zero-to-Low Drop shoes are built to place your foot in a natural position, with a stable and confident foundation to run on.
